title: Decorators
description: The shared library of value transforms a Define Variable value source (or a data-fed parameter) can be chained through. Consumed by the renderer and by the Python compiler — see blocks/README.md.

input_type.description: What it takes from the previous step (an int counts as a string).

output_type.description: What it produces. int (length) is a string to later steps, but the compiler declares the variable int when it's the last step — string => length(...) is a fatal error on an unresolved list.

expression.description: Wraps the incoming value, which appears as {"previous": "value"}; nested inline.

fallback.description: Instead of an expression: the incoming value is stored in an intermediate var (<name>__in), and the result is that value unless it's undefined (e.g. the file was missing) or equals `trigger`, else `value` — two promises, since a function over an undefined var never evaluates at all.
